content: डीन {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [डी-क्त] Flown up. .{@-नम्@} The flight of a bird. The varieties of the flight of birds are said to be 101, the word prefixed to डीन showing the particular mode of flight; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} अवडीनम्, उड्डीनम्, प्रडीनम्, अभिडीनम्, विडीनम्, परिडीनम्, पराडीनम् <ab>&c.</ab> See <ls>Mb. 8. 41. 26-28</ls>.
